verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page claims bulk actions through its built-in MCP server: renaming, sorting and aligning layers automatically, replacing placeholder text across every layer, and swapping light components for dark ones without manual swaps. Most of this is marketing-level copy, with no detailed docs on scope, limits or selection controls and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of bulk-operation scope and limits, independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-item AI edits, documented batch selection and undo behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Sort, rename, and align layers automatically. Wrangle icon sets, keep Libraries clean, and bring calm to chaotic files.
Replace placeholder text across every layer with true-to-life, context-aware content.
Switch light mode components for their dark mode counterparts — all without making a single manual swap.
Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
